product.mission: Suggest the best 6-hero Marvel Rivals team comp for your locked picks, the enemy picks, and bans — a transparent additive log-odds model over a daily RivalsMeta snapshot, running entirely in the browser on GitHub Pages with no backend.

direction.theme: Off-main-thread solve for phones: compose + backups + bans + explain in a dedicated Web Worker with cancellation; Rust/WASM (Step B) only if the 4x-throttled compose wall-clock stays over 1 s
direction.why: The solve blocks the UI on mobile; season 18 quadrupled active team-ups and the smoke budget had to be raised from 2 s to 4 s

direction.theme: Model calibration from sampled matches: pair synergy, learned counters, and backtest-fitted weights maturing as the daily sampler accumulates data
direction.why: Those terms are zero until ~2-4 weeks of sampled comps exist; calibration.json is what makes displayed win probabilities honest

desiredPatterns.name: Engine is pure and DOM-free: src/web/lib/engine imports only data-schema types and sibling modules — no fetch, window, document, or React
Single seam: components call the engine only through src/web/app/local-api.ts, which owns the table caches; no component imports lib/engine directly
Transparent additive model, not ML: every score term is inspectable and explanations are the model's own contributions
Fail-safe data pipeline: ingest validates with zod + sanity gates and never overwrites the last good snapshot

prGates: npm run test green (vitest: engine + ingest + backtest suites; enforced by deploy-pages.yml)
npm run build green (next build static export; enforced by deploy-pages.yml)
